identities.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: a username — the MinIO user the chart creates, twinned with infra/helm/minio/values.yaml
identities.FLYTE_DB_USER: a Postgres role name — it OWNS a database
identities.MARTS_DB_USER: a Postgres role name — it OWNS a database
identities.METABASE_ADMIN_EMAIL: a login identity, stored in the Metabase app-db
identities.METABASE_DB_USER: a Postgres role name — it OWNS a database
identities.MINIO_ROOT_USER: a username (the MinIO root account's name)
identities.MLFLOW_ARTIFACT_BUCKET: a bucket name — renaming it orphans every artifact
identities.MLFLOW_DB_USER: a Postgres role name — it OWNS a database
identities.MLFLOW_S3_ENDPOINT_URL: an endpoint — the host-side address of MinIO, twinned with the port family
identities.MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI: an endpoint — the host-side address of the tracking server, not a credential
identities.OPTUNA_DB_USER: a Postgres role name — it OWNS a database

postgres.mechanism: ALTER ROLE — five tenants via scripts/postgres_databases.sh, the superuser here

minio-users.mechanism: mc admin user add (re-issues an existing accessKey's secret in place)

minio-root.mechanism: Secret minio-root + rollout restart deploy/minio (the PVC keeps every object)

grafana.mechanism: Secret monitoring/grafana-admin + restart (persistence is OFF, so the admin is re-created from it)

metabase-admin.mechanism: PUT /api/user/:id/password (the app-db is persistent; no Secret carries this)
metabase-admin.verified: a fresh POST /api/session on the new password returned a session

sanction: AWAITING_PO 2026-08-24-5, answer 2 (YES, in-place preferred over destroy+rebuild)
no_values_recorded: this record names what rotated, never to what — old or new
consumers_converged: flyte (helm upgrade via deploy_flyte.sh — values-rendered credentials)
